title: 没了NBA：华纳兄弟利润反而涨了？，成本大降EBITDA提升
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In earnings Warner Brothers Discovery reported an 11% drop in revenue year over year, the slump coming in part due to losing NBA rights. In a weaker movie lineup,
segments.zh: 华纳兄弟探索公司财报显示，营收同比下降11%，部分原因是失去了NBA转播权，以及电影阵容较弱。

segments.en: let's get more with Bloomberg Intelligence media analyst Geitha Roganathan. And of course, the backdrop for all of this is the drama continuing as to whether the courts will allow Paramount
segments.zh: 我们连线彭博智库媒体分析师Geitha Roganathan。当然，这一切的背景是法院是否允许派拉蒙收购的戏剧性事件仍在继续。

segments.en: to actually buy the thing Geitha. What was the setup for this? What did we learn in today's earnings?
segments.zh: Geitha，这次财报的背景是什么？我们从今天的财报中了解到什么？

segments.en: Yes, so the earnings were fine, Danny. I mean, as you pointed out, yeah, we did have that drop in revenue. You had a 30% decline in advertising. And of course, 20% of that was because of the lack of
segments.zh: 是的，财报还算可以，Danny。正如你指出的，营收确实下降了，广告收入下降了30%，其中20%是因为没有NBA。

segments.en: NBA. On the flip side, though, the good part of it was that, you know, we also had EBITDA that actually got a little bit of a bump, the TD EBITDA, especially because of those lower costs with no NBA.
segments.zh: 但另一方面，好消息是EBITDA有所提升，尤其是因为没有了NBA，成本降低了。

segments.en: Studio was mixed, you know, Supergirl hasn't really delivered. Streaming though was very, very good.
segments.zh: 工作室业务表现参差不齐，超级少女表现不佳，但流媒体业务非常好。

segments.en: So the fundamentals seem okay. But as you pointed out, the earnings are just a side show at this point. It's really all about that Paramount Skydance transaction, which has now been delayed from September
segments.zh: 基本面似乎没问题。但正如你所说，财报目前只是次要的，关键在于派拉蒙与Skydance的交易，该交易已从今年9月推迟到明年6月。

segments.en: of this year to probably June of next year. And that makes it risky to think about what kind of company is going to exist next year. So I'm wondering what, if anything, the earnings tell us about
segments.zh: 这使得思考明年会存在什么样的公司变得有风险。我想知道，财报是否告诉我们关于华纳兄弟新管理层的什么信息？他们上任才一年左右。

segments.en: the Warner Brothers new management. They've only been in place for about a year. If you had to discount the idea of the merger, what did we learn? Yes, I think, Mike, what we're seeing is that
segments.zh: 如果抛开合并的想法，我们学到了什么？是的，我认为，Mike，我们看到的是华纳兄弟的基本面故事实际上相当不错。

segments.en: the Warner Brothers' fundamental story is actually in pretty good shape. So this management team,
